metadata.title: Bevacizumab 10 mg/kg and Paclitaxel 80 mg/m2
metadata.indication: Adult patients with triple-negative or HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer; review line of therapy against the product indication and local approval.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent review pending

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
metadata.schedule_summary: Bevacizumab 10 mg/kg is given on Days 1 and 15, with paclitaxel 80 mg/m² on Days 1, 8 and 15 of each 28-day cycle. Continue according to benefit, toxicity and the treating team’s plan.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the current NCCP source. It does not replace the NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review or pharmacy verification.

neuropathy_grade.label: Neuropathy grade
neuropathy_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess sensory and/or motor symptoms and their effect on instrumental versus self-care activities of daily living. Distinguish transient cold sensitivity from persistent functional neuropathy.

supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for low emetogenic risk
supportive_care.mapping_basis: Weekly solvent-based paclitaxel low emetogenic risk with day-specific hypersensitivity prophylaxis; bevacizumab minimal. Do not carry paclitaxel premedicines into bevacizumab-only administration.
regimen_specific_notes: First paclitaxel dose: dexamethasone 8 mg IV, chlorphenamine 10 mg IV and famotidine 20 mg IV 30 minutes before.

From Day 8 onward, source table omits routine dexamethasone; add if increased risk/prior reaction under consultant guidance. Chlorphenamine continues; famotidine may be omitted if no reaction under consultant guidance.
NCCP provides antiemetic guidance separately: reconcile total steroid exposure with premedication and local prescribing plan.
Bevacizumab requires blood-pressure and urine-protein review; surgery/wound-healing precautions are separate from chemotherapy support.

indications.description: Adult patients with triple-negative or HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer; review line of therapy against the product indication and local approval.

treatment_phases.label: Bevacizumab with weekly paclitaxel

administration.notes: First 90 min, second 60 min, then 30 min if tolerated. Rapid infusion requires separate local off-label governance.
Over 1 hour; non-PVC apparatus and 0.22 μm filter. Solvent-based paclitaxel premedication required.

treatment_phases.duration_text: Until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. Assess each medicine separately if one is held or stopped.
